prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the medieval town of Albarracín, Aragon, Spain, at night. Honest mostly dark treatment — no invented floodlighting. The pink-walled town with its reddish rodeno houses and medieval walls lying dark under moonlight and a starry sky, a few scattered street lamps catching fragments of the narrow alleys, the walls snaking up the hillside faintly lit by moon, the Guadalaviar river valley dark below. No identifiable people. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
